items.title: How much does it cost to get a smart lock installed?

expanded_element.title: Are Smart Locks Easy to Install? - Lockly
expanded_element.description: Hiring a professional to install your smart lock can cost anywhere from about $80 to $340 per door, though local locksmith rates will, of course, vary. The complexity of the lock affects the cost, too, with additional features like cameras, sensors and multiple locks naturally adding to the labor cost.
